transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi… yeah, thanks for seeing me. I guess I’m here because my eating’s been kind of getting away from me lately. Like after a long shift, or if I’ve been studying, I’ll plan to just grab something quick, but then I end up eating a lot more than I meant to—like a whole fast-food meal, then snacks, and sometimes whatever’s in the fridge too, all in one sitting. It feels a little embarrassing to say, but… I figured I should probably ask someone about it.
Do you usually feel guilty after eating that much?

I mean… maybe a little? I’m not sure I’d call it guilt exactly. I mostly just feel kind of uncomfortable with myself afterward, like, “Why did I do that?” But I try not to make a huge deal out of it. Is that what you mean?
How often do these episodes of eating a lot more than you meant to happen?

Most weeks it’s… at least one night, I think. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but it’s been happening pretty regularly for a few months. And sometimes after, I’ll try to kind of “fix” it—like skip a meal, work out extra, or… sometimes make myself throw up or take something. I know that probably doesn’t sound great.
How often do you make yourself throw up or take something after one of these eating episodes?

Um… not every time. I don’t want you to think I’m doing it constantly, but… sometimes after I eat too much, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. And other times I’ll take laxatives. It’s mostly because I get scared about what all that food is going to do to me, if that makes sense.
How many times a week do you make yourself throw up or take laxatives after eating?

I guess… maybe a couple times a week? Not every time I overeat, but sometimes after I eat too much I’ll go make myself throw up, or I’ll take laxatives. I know that probably sounds bad… I just get really scared about what the food is going to do to me.
Do you try to make yourself throw up or take laxatives every time you overeat?

No… not every time. I mean, sometimes I can just kind of sit with it, or try to move on. But yeah, there are times after I eat too much where I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, or I’ll take laxatives. I know it’s not a good way to handle it… I just get really scared about what the food is going to do to me.
On average, how many times a week do you eat a lot more than you meant to without then making yourself throw up, taking laxatives, or trying to compensate in some other way?

Um… I guess that happens too. Like after a long shift, or if I’ve been studying and I’m tired, I’ll mean to just grab something quick, and then it turns into a full fast-food meal, snacks, and then stuff from the fridge when I get home… all kind of in one sitting.

I don’t always do anything after, though. Maybe… a few times a week? I’m not sure if that’s the kind of number you mean.
Do you think your weight is normal, too high, or too low?

I mean… I know on paper I’m probably not, like, extremely one way or the other. But to me it feels too high, I guess.

Like I’ll look in the mirror before heading to the shop, and if my stomach or chest looks soft, it just… it makes me feel sloppy, like in general, not just how I look. I know that probably sounds kind of dramatic.
How many times a week do you eat a lot more than you meant to without doing anything to try to compensate for it?

I think… maybe around three times a week? It’s not like I’m trying to do it on purpose, but I’ll get off a long shift or finish studying and I’ll end up eating way more than I meant to—like a whole fast-food meal, then snacks, and whatever’s in the fridge—just kind of all in one sitting. And those times I don’t always do anything after. Does that sound like the kind of thing you’re asking?
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

Um… not after every time, and I’m not proud of it. But sometimes when I feel like I ate too much, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I get scared about what the food is going to do to me.

I don’t know the exact number… maybe a couple times in a week, depending on how bad things are. And sometimes it’s not throwing up, it’s taking laxatives instead. I know that’s not good.
Do you make yourself throw up or take laxatives after every binge eating episode?

Not every single time, no. I mean… sometimes I just feel awful about it and I don’t do anything.

But yeah, other times, if I feel like I ate too much, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, or I’ll take laxatives. It’s mostly because I get scared about what the food is going to do to me. I know that probably sounds bad… but it’s not after every episode.
How often do you eat a lot more than you meant to without doing anything to try to compensate for it, such as making yourself throw up, taking laxatives, or exercising extra?

Yeah… I mean, that happens. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but lately after a long shift or when I’m done studying, I’ll end up eating way more than I meant to—like a full fast-food meal, then snacks, then whatever’s in the fridge—kind of all in one sitting.

And sometimes I don’t really do anything after to make up for it. That’s what you mean, right?
How many times a week do you eat a lot more than you meant to, without then making yourself throw up, taking laxatives, or doing anything else to try to compensate for it?

Maybe… a couple times a week? I don’t track it exactly.

It’s usually when I get off a long shift or finish studying and I’m really tired, and then I’ll eat way more than I planned—like a full fast-food meal, then snacks, then whatever’s in the fridge. And sometimes I just don’t do anything after. I know that’s probably not great, but… yeah, maybe around two times a week.
How many times a week do you have episodes where you eat a lot more than you meant to, without then making yourself throw up, taking laxatives, or doing anything else to try to compensate for it?

Yeah… like I said, it’s probably around a couple times a week. Not every day or anything.

It’s usually after a long shift or when I’m done studying and I’m just worn out, and then I’ll eat way more than I planned—like a full fast-food meal, then snacks, then whatever’s in the fridge, kind of all in one sitting. And those are the times I don’t always do anything afterward.
How many times a week do you have episodes where you eat a lot more than you meant to, without then making yourself throw up, taking laxatives, or doing anything else to try to compensate for it?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t have an exact count, but it’s been happening lately after I get off a long shift or finish studying. I’ll end up eating way more than I planned—like a full fast-food meal, then snacks, then whatever’s in the fridge, all in one sitting.

So… I guess around a couple times a week, if I’m being honest. Is that the kind of episode you mean?
How many times in the past month have you made yourself throw up after eating?

Um… yeah, I have done that. I’m kind of embarrassed to say it.

In the past month… maybe around, like, 8 or 10 times? Not every time I overeat, but sometimes after I eat too much I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I get really scared about what the food’s going to do to me. A couple times I’ve taken laxatives too, but the throwing up is… probably the main thing.
Do you make yourself throw up after most of your binge eating episodes?

Not most of them, no… at least I don’t think so.

Sometimes after I eat too much, I do go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, or I’ll take laxatives because I start panicking about what the food is going to do to me. But it’s not every single time. I know that probably doesn’t sound great… but yeah, it happens sometimes.
How many times a week do you have episodes where you eat a lot more than you meant to, without doing anything to try to compensate for it?

Yeah… I think that’s kind of what I was trying to say earlier. It’s not like every day, but lately after a long shift or when I’m done studying, I’ll sort of lose track and eat way more than I meant to—like a whole fast-food meal, then snacks, then stuff from the fridge all in one sitting.

Without doing anything after… maybe a couple times a week? I’m not totally sure if I’m counting it right, but that sounds about right.
How many times a month do you make yourself throw up after eating?

I think… like I said, maybe around 8 to 10 times in a month? I’m not proud of that.

It’s usually when I feel like I ate too much and I start freaking out, so I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. Sometimes I’ve used laxatives instead, but the throwing up is probably the main thing.
Do you make yourself throw up after more than half of your binge eating episodes?

I don’t think it’s more than half… I mean, sometimes after I eat too much I do go to the bathroom and make myself throw up, or I’ll take laxatives because I get scared about what the food’s going to do to me.

But if you’re asking more than half of the binges, I don’t think so. I hope I’m answering that right.

doctor.intent: determine frequency of self-induced vomiting in relation to binge eating episodes
doctor.question: Do you make yourself throw up after more than half of your binge eating episodes?
